fields.title: An AI industry downturn sets in by May 18, 2027
fields.text: The AI build-out breaks: by May 18, 2027 the AI industry is in a recognised downturn, as Polymarket's 'AI industry downturn' market defines it (at least three of its six triggers, such as a collapse in GPU rental prices, met within 90 days), rather than a correction in share prices alone.
fields.resolution_source: Polymarket 'AI bubble burst by...?' market rules
